status_summary: USDA has continued to run the program. On 2026-02-10 it opened 2026 continuous and general signups, noting that CRP was close to its 27-million-acre statutory cap with about 1.9 million acres available for the fiscal year, and on 2026-07-07 it announced acceptance of 2.2 million acres out of about 2.5 million acres offered across the general, grassland and continuous signups. The House Agriculture Committee advanced the Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026 (H.R. 7567) by 34-17 in early March 2026, and the House passed it 224-200 on 2026-04-30; Quail Forever reports that it reauthorizes CRP through 2031 and codifies the SAFE initiative within continuous signup. USDA's FY2027 explanatory notes for the Commodity Credit Corporation estimate CRP outlays of about 1.99 billion dollars for 2027 against about 1.90 billion estimated for 2026 and keep the 27-million-acre cap, with no reduction or elimination proposed in the portions read. A CRS primer dated 2026-04-13 says CRP's authority has run on short extensions since the end of FY2023 and was extended through FY2026, and that without authority CRP could not enroll new or expiring acres.

timeline.event: USDA announces 2026 enrollment: continuous CRP (Signup 65) from 2026-02-12 to 2026-03-20 and general CRP (Signup 66) from 2026-03-09 to 2026-04-17, with CRP near its 27-million-acre cap and about 1.9 million acres available; the release says FSA's authority to run CRP was extended through 2026-09-30.

Quail Forever reports (publication date; the markup was the week before) that the House Agriculture Committee advanced the Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026 by 34-17 with all Republicans and seven Democrats in favor, and that the bill reauthorizes CRP through 2031.

CRS Farm Bill Primer on the conservation title states that CRP has a 27-million-acre cap for FY2026, that its authority was extended through FY2026 and is the largest conservation program set to expire then, that CBO puts outlays near $2.0 billion a year, and that the House Agriculture Committee ordered H.R. 7567 reported.

The House passes the Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026 (H.R. 7567), 224-200 (Roll Call 154); per Quail Forever, the bill reauthorizes CRP through 2031 and includes an amendment codifying the SAFE initiative within continuous CRP. The bill text was not read.

Whether the Senate acted on a farm bill, and whether CRP authority was extended past 2026-09-30 (Public Law 119-103's agriculture extensions, as read earlier, do not name CRP), was not established. The FY2027 CRP figures come from the first part of the CCC explanatory notes, which the reader tool truncated; the document prints no publication date (its source date is given as the fiscal year label FY2027), and a FY2027 USDA budget summary and FSA chapter fetched did not mention CRP.
